Coram: Hon'Ble Mrs. Justice P Sree Sudha
 Oral Judgment
1. Learned counsel for the appellant and respondents are present.
2.
This appeal is filed against the common award of the Tribunal in MVC No.88/2020 dated 31.12.2022.
It is a case of injury and this appeal is filed against the award of the Tribunal for enhancement of the compensation.
3. At the time of arguments, learned counsel for the appellant stated his intention to examine the Neurosurgeon to ensure proper assessment of the disability.
Therefore, the matter is remanded to the Trial Court with a specific direction to provide reasonable opportunity to both parties to adduce evidence and to present arguments.
The Trial Court shall dispose of the matter on its merits, duly considering the entire evidence on record, within two months from the date of this order.
The Registry is directed to send the records to the trial Court within 10 days.
Both the parties are directed to appear before the tribunal on 16.03.2026.
